name: std::isupper(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool isupper(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as an uppercase alphabetic character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as uppercase, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
isupper('Þ', C locale) returned false
islower('Þ', C locale) returned false
isupper('Þ', Unicode locale) returned true
islower('Þ', Unicode locale) returned false

summary: Checks if the given character is classified as an uppercase alphabetic character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.
